pages.title: Armor with Attitude
pages.text: Obtain one Resisteel armor piece and one Resisteel tool or sword.

pages.title: Armor with Attitude
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Resisteel equipment has its own interactions. Compare the armor and tool descriptions first; this step checks acquisition, not ability activation.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Classified armor/elytra/weapons may receive actual durability even when originally nondamageable; adapter permits Unbreaking/Mending, so do not assume it is everlasting.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Current Void Walker enchant adapter clears fall accumulation while natively supported over air, standing and not sneaking. It grants no enchant/armor and this source does not establish an on/off key.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: The requested full-set toggle cannot be presented as implemented: inspected VoidWalkerEvents contains no such toggle. Follow actual item guidance rather than invent a key.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Resisteel armor stacks defense with slowing; its sword benefits from high armor and tools grant sneaking Haste at a movement cost.
